title: Why are people saying GTA 6 is woke? The review-bombing fight
answer: Some players are calling Grand Theft Auto VI "woke" over its story, its two protagonists and its relationship mechanics, and many flooded Metacritic with low user scores when reviews opened on Nov. 20, 2026. Critics still rate it 99/100; the user score fell to about 5 out of 10.
body:
"GTA 6 is woke" is a culture-war complaint, not a description of a specific feature. Gamers use "woke" as a catch-all for anything they see as political or progressive. In this case, the targets are the game's story, its two leads, Lucia and Jason, and the way their relationship works in the game. You'll see it used both sincerely and as bait, as in "GTA 6 is woke, refund incoming."

GTA 6 launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on Nov. 19, 2026. When Metacritic opened user reviews a day later, they turned negative fast. GameRant reported a 4.9 user score and TheGamer a 5.1, with more than half of user reviews negative, while the critic Metascore held at 99 across more than 150 reviews. Both outlets called it review bombing: many negative reviews used labels like "woke" or "DEI," and TheGamer noted that a lot of the reviewers admitted they hadn't played the game.

A related rumor, "Lucia cheats on Jason," spread on Nov. 20 as players pointed to secrets Lucia keeps in the story. A spoiler explainer from Beebom says she does not cheat on or betray him; her secrets are tied to her family. Not every bad review is political: TheGamer notes real complaints about console performance, controls and missing features from earlier games. Our earlier page covers those: https://trendrundown.com/x/why-are-people-saying-gta-6-is-bad.

For parents: GTA 6 is rated M (Mature 17+). The "woke" argument is about politics and story, not about new content in the game.
in_the_news: Metacritic opened user reviews for GTA 6 on Nov. 20, 2026, and the user score dropped to about 5/10 within hours.

faq.a: It's when a large number of people post low ratings at once, often for reasons outside the product itself, to drag down its score.
Critics give it 99/100 from more than 150 reviews. The user score was around 4.9 to 5.1 out of 10 on Nov. 20, 2026, and it may change.

faq.q: Does Lucia cheat on Jason in GTA 6?
faq.a: According to Beebom's spoiler explainer, no. She keeps secrets for family reasons but stays loyal to Jason through the ending.
GameRant notes that some reviews may be removed, but Metacritic has not announced what it will do.
